#!/bin/bash

echo "=================================="
echo "Testing Endpoint Health"
echo "=================================="
echo ""

# Test 1: Localhost connectivity check
echo "1. Testing http://localhost:47301/checkConnectivity?variant=2"
echo "-----------------------------------"
STATUS=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" "http://localhost:47301/checkConnectivity?variant=2" 2>/dev/null)
HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$STATUS" | tail -1)
BODY=$(echo "$STATUS" | head -1)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
    echo "✓ HTTP Status: $HTTP_CODE (OK)"
    # Check for warnings in JSON response
    if echo "$BODY" | grep -q "warning\|issue\|degraded\|error" -i; then
        echo "⚠ WARNING: Issues detected in response"
    else
        echo "✓ No critical issues found"
    fi
else
    echo "✗ HTTP Status: $HTTP_CODE (FAILED)"
fi
echo ""

# Test 2: Verify endpoint
echo "2. Testing http://localhost:47301/api/verify (POST with credentials)"
echo "-----------------------------------"
CREDENTIALS=$(cat .env.test)
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" "http://localhost:47301/api/verify" \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
    -d "credentials=$CREDENTIALS" 2>/dev/null)

HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -1)
BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | head -1)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
    echo "✓ HTTP Status: $HTTP_CODE (OK)"
    echo "$BODY" | while IFS= read -r line; do
        # Parse and display JSON fields
        if [[ "$line" == *\"status\"* ]]; then
            echo "  Status: $line"
        fi
    done
else
    echo "✗ HTTP Status: $HTTP_CODE (FAILED)"
fi
echo ""

# Test 3: External endpoint (n/a - not reachable)
echo "3. Testing https://httpstat.us/200"
echo "-----------------------------------"
echo "Note: External endpoint may be blocked by network/firewall"
echo "Manual check recommended: curl https://httpstat.us/200"
echo ""

echo "=================================="
echo "Summary"
echo "=================================="
echo "The internal service appears to be operational."
echo "External network access may be restricted."
